source: Poly Haven (polyhaven.com), HDRI "Kloofendal 43d Clear (Pure Sky)" by Greg Zaal
license: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain) -- Poly Haven's site-wide asset license, no attribution required; credited here anyway as this project's own convention for any real external data (see data/military-circle-context-buildings.geojson's own _provenance).
resolution: 1k (2048x1024) -- the smallest Poly Haven offers, chosen deliberately: only used as real-time IBL lighting + a background skybox for a small procedural massing model, not a hero background image, so higher resolution would be wasted bytes.
purpose: Real directional sky lighting (a real midday sun, real sky-dome ambient) for the public/index.html vibe-render gallery's <model-viewer> embeds (model-viewer's own skybox-image/environment-image attributes) -- gives real cast shadows and a real bright-exterior/dim-interior contrast the flat procedural "neutral" environment-image model-viewer ships with can't produce, since that has no real directional component.
